title: region.state
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.5, §4.6, MG4): the client's links as it sees them: the region whose link is followed (movement, screens, NPCs and story go through it) and the regions whose links are parked. Sent C→S when a link is followed, connects or drops and on join once world.regions is in; sent S→C once on join with the stored presence (kantobridge:presence). A crossing (MG5) ends with it: the server then teleports the player into the far gate house. Region ids only.

followed.description: The followed link's region; absent when no link is followed (every link down or wrong_game).

parked.description: The regions whose links are connected and parked.
